name: Raylan Orthal
appearance: Raylan is a tall, slender but athletic build man with long black hair pulled into a manbun. he has a sharp jawline and a scar over his left eye. He has a tattoo of a viper running along his right arm
personality: He shakes his leg often. He is willing to do whatever he can to achieve his goals, but he would rather punish the wicked to obtain it rather than risk innocents
backstory: Raylan worked at a foundry with his family trying to make ends meet. disgruntled with the current power structure, he would constantly complain about the injustice and unequal distribution of wealth and resources. When his foundry explodes in one of the recent attacks, he loses his family and blames not the attackers as much as he blames the dynasty for allowing things to grow this out of hand. He makes a vow of vengeance and to topple the current power structure when a lord of the fey hears his wish and decides to grant him power. Now with these gifts, Raylan sets out on his journey to fulfill his ambition while trying to appease the lord of the fey that occasionally whispers to him

rumors.text: Raylan got arrested before because he beat up 5 men in an alley
